title: How Does the Heart Pump Blood?

input.text:
Your pulse is your heart squeezing: it pumps all of your blood round your body in about a minute.

The heart is a muscle, and it squeezes. Each squeeze pushes blood out into the arteries, and that push is the pulse you feel in your wrist. The blood comes back through the veins, round and round: your heart pumps all of it round your body in about a minute.

How does the heart pump blood?
